trial_title: Registry of Multimodality Treatment for Brain Arteriovenous Malformation in Mainland China

They were divided into experimental group and control group according to whether the treatment plan was formulated by a multidisciplinary team. eligibility_table.criterion: The diagnosis of AVM was confirmed with digital subtraction angiography (DSA) and/or magnetic resonance imaging(MRI).
eligibility_table.justification: The patient has a diagnosis of AVM, but it is unclear if it was confirmed with DSA or MRI.
eligibility_table.clinical_question: Has the patient undergone digital subtraction angiography (DSA) or magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) to confirm the diagnosis of arteriovenous malformation (AVM)?

eligibility_table.criterion: Patients with complete clinical and imaging data.
eligibility_table.justification: The patient has relevant clinical and imaging data related to their condition.

eligibility_table.criterion: Patient or patient's legal representative agreed to collection of information for this study and signed informed consent.
eligibility_table.justification: There is no information provided about whether the patient or their legal representative signed informed consent.
eligibility_table.clinical_question: Has the patient signed the informed consent form for participation in the study?

eligibility_table.criterion: Received other treatment (surgery, embolization or SRS) before inclusion;
eligibility_table.justification: The patient has not received any prior treatments such as surgery, embolization, or SRS.

eligibility_table.criterion: Expected survival time is less than 6 months;
eligibility_table.justification: There is no indication that the patient's expected survival time is less than 6 months.
The patient has an AVM in the brain, not a spinal AVM.

eligibility_table.criterion: Patients missing critical baseline and imaging data.
eligibility_table.justification: It is unclear if there are any missing critical baseline and imaging data.
eligibility_table.clinical_question: Does the patient have complete baseline imaging data, including MRI and angiography, necessary for evaluating the arteriovenous malformation?
